title: Squidward Crying
blurb: Squidward sobbing — the most theatrical despair in Bikini Bottom, from the character who most deserves it. His misery is eternal, artistic, and entirely self-aware, which makes this cry perfect for dramatizing your own smallest defeats: Mondays, missed buses, being perceived. We are all Squidward eventually; this button just accepts it early.
origin: Squidward's dramatic sobbing from SpongeBob SquarePants.
